verdict: The governance guard plugin is the only fully automated, high-quality, self-testing automation component in the entire repository. All 9 BLOCK rules, 51/51 tests, and string-aware CC-position-aware parsing make it production-grade. Everything else — defect scanning, registry generation, baselines management, certification pipeline, pre-delivery safety check — requires manual invocation by a human or agent. The S362 score of 48/100 is ACCURATE and the 53.1% uncategorized script rate confirms the sprawl problem.
